title: Faster-WAM: Do World Action Models Need Deep Action Modules?
abstract: arXiv:2608.02365v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) build on pretrained video models, whose representations are grounded in physical dynamics and provide a natural basis for action prediction. Despite this natural foundation, many WAMs still rely on deep, parameter-heavy action-prediction modules that incur high inference latency and may overfit to limited robot demonstrations, restricting their real-world applicability. In this paper, we advocate a world-model-centric principle that concentrates capacity and computation in the video world model, while a lightweight action expert translates the backbone's representations into executable robot actions. translated_title: Faster-WAM：世界动作模型需要深层动作模块吗？
translated_abstract: 世界动作模型（World Action Models, WAMs）构建于预训练视频模型之上，这些模型的表示根植于物理动力学，为动作预测提供了天然基础。尽管具备这种天然优势，许多WAM仍然依赖深层的、参数繁多的动作预测模块，这会导致较高的推理延迟，并可能在有限的机器人演示数据上过拟合，从而限制其实际应用。在本文中，我们提倡一种以世界模型为中心的设计原则：将模型容量和计算集中于视频世界模型本身，而由一个轻量级动作专家将骨干网络的表示转化为可执行的机器人动作。我们通过三个关键选择来实现这一原则：采用Dock of Transformers（DoT）结合Lite KV-Fusion，使浅层、轻量级的动作专家能够访问所有视频层的表示；动作专家仅以世界模型为条件（world-model-only conditioning）；以及使用收缩式1D-RoPE实现视频与动作之间的位置对齐……
tldr: 提出Faster-WAM，通过以世界模型为中心的设计，用浅层轻量级动作专家（配合DoT、Lite KV-Fusion、仅世界模型条件化及收缩式1D-RoPE）替代深层动作模块，将计算集中于视频世界模型，从而降低推理延迟并缓解过拟合问题。
en_tdlr: Faster-WAM advocates a world-model-centric principle that concentrates capacity in the video world model while a shallow, lightweight action expert—with DoT and Lite KV-Fusion, world-model-only conditioning, and retracted 1D-RoPE—translates representations into robot actions, reducing inference latency and overfitting compared to deep action modules.
